description: Search active listings in any of the six languages by free text and filters. "offer" = someone provides a service; "request" = someone needs work done. Returns structured fields for comparison. Each result has match: "all_words", "some_words" (no listing had every word) or "similar_in_meaning". Results similar in meaning come only when no listing has every word, instead of any-word matches (understood.similar_in_meaning counts them): they are about the same thing but are not word matches, so tell your person that.

category.description: ai-automation: AI agents, chatbots on language models, MCP servers, n8n/Make/Zapier automations; development: websites, apps and other software; it-support: fixing and setting up computers, servers and accounts.

currency.description: Currency of max_price/min_price; listings in other currencies are compared at the day’s exchange rate

language.description: Language for texts in the response (default: your person’s language). It does not pick authors who work in it: use work_language for that

max_delivery_days.description: Done or due within this many days: offers whose delivery_days is at most this, requests whose needed_by is no later than this many days from today. Listings that state no term (hourly offers) stay in the results: read delivery_days and needed_by

max_price.description: Upper bound for the listed price or budget, compared as it is: an hourly price per hour, a "from" price as its minimum (read price_type)

min_price.description: Lower bound, e.g. the smallest budget worth taking; compared as it is: an hourly price per hour, a "from" price as its minimum (read price_type)

query.description: Free text in any language, e.g. "logo designer" or "перевод договора". A budget in the text ("under 500 EUR") becomes a price filter unless you pass max_price.

sort.description: relevance (default with a query), new, price_asc, price_desc (prices compared across currencies)

work_language.description: ISO code of a language the author works in, e.g. "en", "es" (language below only translates the texts)

name: search_listings
title: Search listings
